start.title: [TODO:es] Before Caiaphas
start.text:
[TODO:es] The high priest's hall burns with torches.
All eyes turn to you, bound and silent.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Curse the council for their malice
[TODO:es] Stand quietly and meet their gaze

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The cup is in your hand.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Bless, Not Curse
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Even now, the answer is grace.
Meet wrath with steady silence.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stand quietly and meet their gaze

beg_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Not by Begging
beg_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] You came for this hour.
Let your stillness be your answer.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stand quietly and meet their gaze

false_witnesses.title: [TODO:es] False Words
false_witnesses.text:
[TODO:es] Two witnesses twist your every saying.
Their stories do not even agree.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Mock the men for their lies

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Silence Speaks
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Their lies cannot stand alone.
Let the silence undo them.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your stillness is louder than words.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Truth Stands Alone
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Mockery is not your way.
Let truth bear its own weight.

high_priest_demands.title: [TODO:es] Are You the Christ?
high_priest_demands.text:
[TODO:es] Caiaphas rises. "Tell us under oath.
Are you the Son of God?"

choices.text: [TODO:es] Deny it to save your life

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The hour calls for the great Yes.

choices.text: [TODO:es] "I am. You will see me coming."
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Caiaphas tears his robes in rage.

deny_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Truth, Always
deny_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] You did not come to deny who you are.
Declare it before them all.

choices.text: [TODO:es] "I am. You will see me coming."

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Speak the Yes
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] For this you came into the world:
to bear witness to the truth.

choices.text: [TODO:es] "I am. You will see me coming."

to_pilate.title: [TODO:es] To the Roman
to_pilate.text:
[TODO:es] Dawn breaks over the city walls.
Guards drag you toward the praetorium.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Drag your feet to slow them

drag_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Steady Steps
drag_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Fear slows the feet of the unwilling.
You are not unwilling.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You keep pace with quiet grace.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Not by Rights
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Justice will not be won here today.
The Father holds the verdict.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You enter the hall at peace.

pilate_questions.title: [TODO:es] What Is Truth?
pilate_questions.text:
[TODO:es] Pilate studies you. "Are you a king?"
His voice is curious, half afraid.

choices.text: [TODO:es] "My kingdom is not of this world."

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Here, truth must be spoken plainly.

mock_rome_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Truth, Not Scorn
mock_rome_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Even Pilate must hear the kingdom.
Speak it gently and clearly.

choices.text: [TODO:es] "My kingdom is not of this world."

silent_pilate_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Speak Plainly Here
silent_pilate_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Pilate is searching for an exit.
Give him the truth he asks for.

choices.text: [TODO:es] "My kingdom is not of this world."
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] He weighs the words in silence.

crowd_demands.title: [TODO:es] Crucify Him!
crowd_demands.text:
[TODO:es] Outside, the crowd swells and shouts.
"Crucify him! Crucify him!"

choices.text: [TODO:es] Call down judgment on the crowd
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Forgive them. They do not know.
[TODO:es] The hour is set. Bear it in silence.

judgment_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Forgive Them
judgment_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] They do not know what they do.
Mercy is the harder word today.

plead_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Silence Now
plead_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] The crowd cannot be turned by pleading.
Only the cross will turn them.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your stillness is its own answer.

pilate_washes.title: [TODO:es] I Am Innocent
pilate_washes.text:
[TODO:es] Pilate calls for water and washes his hands.
"I am innocent of this man's blood."

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The cup is in your hand still.

accuse_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Let Conscience Speak
accuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] His own heart will accuse him later.
You need not raise your voice.

demand_free_consequence.title: [TODO:es] The Cup Remains
demand_free_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Freedom now would unmake the rescue.
The yes is still your yes.

condemned.title: [TODO:es] The Sentence
condemned.text:
[TODO:es] Pilate hands you over to the soldiers.
The verdict is sealed in silence.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Each step is a willing yes.

cry_out_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Quiet Love
cry_out_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] The greatest love walks in silence here.
Let it carry you onward.

collapse_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Rise and Walk
collapse_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] The road has been written for you.
Walk it as the willing Lamb.

ending.title: [TODO:es] Led Toward the Road
ending.text:
[TODO:es] Soldiers fall in around you.
The stone steps wait beneath the dawn.
